name: Honda Precision Parts of Georgia (Transmission Plant) - Tallapoosa GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: A controlled truck checkpoint sits on the east access road: a small guard-booth structure stands beside/in the truck lanes with a parked vehicle next to it and painted lane markings splitting the truck path into multiple lanes (z20 satellite). Clear controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: The small booth-sized structure positioned in the truck lanes at the checkpoint is a staffed guard shack - high confidence from z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false - a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: false - the area before the gate is the wooded access road; no dedicated outside-the-gate truck stalls.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Trailers staged on the apron just inside the checkpoint; broad internal aprons give deep queuing (drivewayLong = true).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Truck lanes at the checkpoint are already split into 2+ marked lanes with paved width to add an express bypass.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock lines with trailers backed in along the south and southwest building faces; ~50 doors estimated - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple organized trailer-parking rows on the south apron and near the checkpoint, ~110 trailers visible - 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on two distinct building faces (south and southwest) - likely separate ship/receive; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - plant is set deep in forested terrain near Tallapoosa, Haralson County, GA; surrounded by woodland with scattered rural homes.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Inferred - the site is rural and ringed by dense forest, away from town fabric; cellular coverage may be weaker. Medium-confidence at best, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large transmission plant building with attached wings plus minor support buildings - one facility cluster.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~130 acres derived from the perimeter box; approximate (much of the surrounding land is forest buffer).
